name: MirrorMe Bolt
summary: A full-size bipedal humanoid (175 cm, 75 kg) built for high-speed running, with two 21-DOF dexterous hands, sold as a research platform for locomotion and manipulation work.

germany.statusNote: OpenELAB's German storefront lists Bolt with a gross price and an add-to-cart button. It is a pre-order item produced to order, with an estimated dispatch of 10-20 days after ordering; the production window is confirmed in writing per order.

priceEur.note: incl. VAT; includes two dexterous hands, charging unit, transport case and calibration accessories (box contents on the page).

germany.leadTime: Estimated dispatch 10-20 days after ordering; produced to order (OpenELAB)

sellers.name: OpenELAB Technology Ltd.
sellers.note: Shenzhen-based reseller with a German storefront; returns address Parkring 31, 85748 Garching bei München. Listed as a pre-order item; a request-for-quote form is offered for institutions.
